cases.setup: Load the candidate test map with two live actors that use UWorldObjectIdentityComponent. Give both the same valid DefinitionId; for the collision case deliberately copy the same authored InstanceId. Start a fresh world-local identity registry and capture the IDs before/after BeginPlay.
cases.action: Exercise UWorldObjectIdentityComponent::BeginPlay → EnsureIdentity → UWorldObjectIdentitySubsystem::RegisterIdentity for both actors. Query each component's InstanceId/DefinitionId after registration and export/restore a supported physical-actor snapshot in a separate save case.

cases.rejectionScenario: Pass an invalid component to RegisterIdentity and verify it returns false. For duplicate live InstanceIds, verify registration resolves the conflict without replacing the existing actor's mapping or leaving duplicate registry entries.
cases.retryScenario: Call EnsureIdentity repeatedly on the same component and re-register the same component; verify the valid ID remains stable. Duplicate registration of a different live component must not result in two actors resolving to the same ID.

Compare item ownership, output actor count, actor transforms, processing state, anchor reservations, structural graph edges, revisions, event count and inventory quantities.
cases.expectedOutcome: The successful request changes all declared participating domains exactly once and returns a single coherent result. A preflight failure changes nothing. An intermediate failure either restores the full pre-state or marks the world faulted and refuses further simulation; it must never silently continue with mixed authoritative state.
cases.rejectionScenario: Force missing output configuration, stale revision, failed ownership transfer, failed actor activation or a capacity conflict. Assert no input consumption, duplicate output, retained anchor reservation or false success event remains.

Run a failure during restore and verify the pre-load snapshot is restored or the coordinator enters its documented fail-closed state.
